Why each library (this file is the canonical external library table; the docs repository links here):
- cgltf: single-file glTF loader.
- Dear ImGui: editor UI (never linked into the shipped game exe).
- ImGuizmo: 3D gizmo in the editor (never linked into the shipped game exe).
- Jolt Physics: deterministic build support, multithreaded, fast. Built with CROSS_PLATFORM_DETERMINISTIC and SSE4.2 only (AVX/FMA off) so it runs on office CPUs (Pentium, Celeron) and gives the same results everywhere.
- meshoptimizer: model optimization and LOD generation.
- miniaudio: audio devices on every target platform (WASAPI, CoreAudio, ALSA/PulseAudio, AAudio, Web Audio), node graph, 3D attenuation, WAV decoding and streaming in one file. The engine's sound events, voice management and buses (mealkit/audio) are built on it. SDL3 was measured instead and not used (+1.6-1.9 MB exe, docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-18).
- RenderDoc in-application API: one header to trigger a GPU capture of the next frame from the editor or a development exe when RenderDoc is installed; nothing is linked or shipped.
- stb (stb_vorbis, stb_truetype, stb_image): single-file public domain / MIT decoders: Ogg Vorbis for streamed music (through miniaudio), TrueType glyphs baked at run time for UI text, PNG for UI images.
- Tracy: CPU/GPU profiling (only in `build.bat Profile`).
- Vulkan Memory Allocator: GPU memory allocation for Vulkan buffers and images (memory types, sub-allocation, mapping). A tested allocator instead of our own, since stage 2 textures and shadow maps add many allocations (docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-19).
- volk: loads vulkan-1.dll at run time and fetches device-level function pointers (one call less per command), so builds need no Vulkan SDK import library and a PC without Vulkan gets a clear error instead of a missing-DLL failure.
- Vulkan-Headers: the Vulkan API declarations for the Vulkan RHI backend (rhi/vulkan). The loader comes with the GPU driver (vulkan-1.dll), so no Vulkan SDK is needed to build or run.
- Steamworks SDK: lobbies, friend invites, relay. Valve's terms forbid redistributing it, so it is not in the repository; put it in third_party/steamworks/sdk and CMake picks it up.

Generated by tools\gen_notices.ps1 from third_party/<lib>/mealkit.txt and LICENSE - do not edit by hand.
To add or update a library: copy its sources into third_party/<lib>/ (only the files needed to build, see 'kept'),
keep its LICENSE, write mealkit.txt (name, version, license, licenseFile, source, usedIn, inGame, kept, why) and run the script.
Shipped games include the notices (the export build merges the engine, game and font notices).
